name: EPIC 249575654

text.card: A red giant 4,634 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 0.84 solar masses and 14.1 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,421 K at its surface.
